name: disorders of sexual differentiation overview
title: Disorders of sexual differentiation pathway: the newborn with ambiguous genitalia is karyotyped first; 46,XY under-virilisation splits into 5-alpha-reductase deficiency, incomplete androgen insensitivity and testis or androgen-synthesis failure, and 46,XX virilisation into salt-wasting and simple virilising 21-hydroxylase deficiency and other sources of fetal androgen, with assessment, management at birth, sex chromosome DSD and non-classic CAH along the bottom

root.title: Newborn with ambiguous genitalia: KARYOTYPE first
lines: disorder of sexual development (DSD) = discrepancy between karyotype, gonads, internal and external genitalia · 1 in 4,500 births
karyotype + pelvic/abdominal ultrasound in every case, then labs by your differential
~not always ambiguous genitalia: may present as abnormal puberty · gender identity, expression and sexual orientation are out of scope

groups.title: 46,XY DSD: under-virilised
lines: gonads: TESTES · external genitalia incompletely virilised

groups.title: 46,XX DSD: virilised
lines: gonads: OVARIES · external genitalia virilised by increased fetal androgen

tiers.title: Which step fails?
lines: testis → testosterone → dihydrotestosterone (DHT) by 5-alpha-reductase → androgen receptor

tiers.title: Congenital adrenal hyperplasia (CAH): 21-hydroxylase deficiency
lines: autosomal recessive · CYP21A2 on chromosome 6 · CAH 1 in 10,000 births
how much enzyme activity is left?

head: h
5-alpha-reductase deficiency
testosterone cannot become DHT
pres: INCOMPLETE virilisation · sparse facial and pubic hair · NO temporal recession or acne
inv: human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) given, then testosterone:DHT (T:DHT) ratio
cause: impaired conversion of testosterone to DHT
tx: 60% assigned female (who virilise at puberty) identify as MALE

head: h
Incomplete androgen insensitivity
androgen RECEPTOR only partly works
pres: external genitalia: ambiguous, micropenis or normal male
tx: 25% have gender dissatisfaction, assigned male or female
~complete androgen insensitivity: 100% assigned female identify as female

head: h
Testis or androgen-synthesis failure
the other 46,XY causes
pres: ~the slides list these causes without separate features
cause: complete or partial GONADAL DYSGENESIS · testes regression
luteinizing hormone (LH) deficiency or LH receptor defect
tx: biosynthetic defects, gonadal dysgenesis: 25% have gender dissatisfaction, assigned male or female

head: h
Salt-wasting 21-hydroxylase deficiency
most severe · 75% of 21-hydroxylase deficiency
pres: neonatal DEATH if not recognised and treated
cause: adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH) excess → adrenal cortex HYPERPLASIA
tx: hydrocortisone 10–15 mg/m²/day, twice or three times daily
+ extra oral saline may be needed in infants
MORE glucocorticoid in illness or stress, to prevent a salt-losing crisis
~90% of 46,XX CAH assigned female identify as female

head: h
Simple virilising 21-hydroxylase deficiency
1 of the 2 mutations is relatively mild
cause: cortisol ↓ · androgen EXCESS · significant salt loss does not occur
tx: more glucocorticoid in illness or stress
markedly virilised 46,XX CAH: raise as female, as recommended

head: h
Other sources of fetal androgen
46,XX without CAH
pres: ~the slides list these causes without separate features

panels.title: Assess the newborn
items: HISTORY: family history of ambiguous genitalia or virilisation · pregnancy: maternal medications and health · neonatal crises
EXAM: general · dysmorphic features · PALPATE the gonads
DESCRIBE + DRAW: labioscrotal folds (appearance, open or fused) · phallus length and width · urogenital openings: number, position, size
NEUTRAL terms: gonads, phallus, labio-scrotal folds

panels.title: Management at birth
items: REFER to a tertiary centre: endocrinology, neonatology, genetics, gynaecology, urology, social work/psychology
DELAY sex of rearing until all investigations are complete · do NOT assign a name · do NOT register the birth
sex assignment does NOT inevitably mean surgery · evidence lacking · individual consideration · expert surgeons only
weigh: diagnosis · genital appearance, surgical options · lifelong replacement · fertility · family views, culture

panels.title: Sex chromosome DSD
items: OVOTESTICULAR DSD: chromosomes variable, gonads mixed
